atAGlance: Bánh flan is Vietnamese caramel flan, usually silky custard with dark caramel and sometimes crushed ice or coffee.
whatItIs: Bánh flan is caramel custard adopted into Vietnam’s dessert-counter culture.
howToEnjoy: Eat it cold and spoon caramel with each bite. Coffee makes it more bitter and grown-up.
howLocalsOrder: Bánh flan is a cool dessert order, often served with coffee syrup or shaved ice. Ask for less ice if you want the custard texture to stay silky.
worthKnowing: Bánh flan reflects Vietnam’s easy adoption of custard into everyday café and dessert-shop culture. It is usually served cold, casual, and often with coffee or caramel syrup.
goodToKnow: Some shops serve flan with coffee poured over ice. Ask if you want it plain.
